patterns.name: jndi-remote-header
patterns.condition: Request user-agent or HTTP header contains complete ${jndi:<remote-scheme>://...} lookup
patterns.evidence: CVE-2021-44228: attacker-supplied logged HTTP header can trigger Log4j JNDI lookup

patterns.name: jndi-remote-query
patterns.condition: Request URL or query parameter contains complete ${jndi:<remote-scheme>://...} lookup
patterns.evidence: CVE-2021-44228 / MITRE ATT&CK T1190: vulnerable HTTP input used for remote lookup

patterns.name: cve-reference-review
patterns.condition: CVE-2021-44228, log4j, or JNDI reference without complete lookup syntax
patterns.evidence: NVD CVE-2021-44228 and ATT&CK T1190: references alone are not proof of exploitation

patterns.name: scanner-trace-review
patterns.condition: Exploit scan/check/lookup hint or T1190-labelled vulnerability alert without complete lookup
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: reconnaissance/scan hints require review, not an automatic block
